material: PETG baseline; ASA or ABS acceptable as equal-or-better thermal substitutes; ordinary PLA is not accepted

details.motherboard: standard Mini-ITX 170 x 170 mm reference interface

motherboard_mounting.support_type: four integral cylindrical printed standoffs: three fused to enclosure hosts and one fused to a detachable lower-front mount arm
motherboard_mounting.fastener: four M3 screws into printed self-forming holes
motherboard_mounting.lower_front_mount_fastener: one underside M3 screw through the base into the detachable printed arm
motherboard_mounting.compatibility_scope: standard Mini-ITX board outline, four-hole mounting pattern, ATX-family rear I/O aperture and generic backside keepout allowance

details.gpu: compact single-fan dual-slot reference envelope, inverted with PCIe fingers upward; GPU power-cable routing is excluded from enclosure acceptance
details.gpu_support: far-end U cradle fused to the removable front panel: 40.8 mm clear inside width for the 40 mm dual-slot reference, 18 mm fore-aft contact depth, support surface 0.8 mm below the 97 mm GPU reference bottom for a soft pad, and unobstructed withdrawal with the front panel; no standalone support component or support fastener
details.psu: standard SFX 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm reference envelope, rear straight-in installation
details.sfx_rear_interface: four 4.2 mm holes at 113 x 51.5 mm spacing with unobstructed driver access
details.layout: six-piece 152 x 256 x 252 mm enclosure with standard rear Mini-ITX I/O, inverted dual-slot GPU, lower PCIe support beam and standard SFX PSU
details.storage: M.2 only; no separate drive bays
details.ventilation: large perforated side panels; solid front panel
details.panel_magnets: 15 x 10 x 4 mm embedded magnets retained by a centered screw
details.priority: verified hardware installation and maintainability within the fixed enclosure envelope

notes: The previous sub-4-liter/Flex-PSU/no-riser/no-GPU-support concept is retired. Current requirements follow the 152 x 256 x 252 mm SFX/riser design with the GPU far-end U support fused to the removable front panel. The motherboard mounts directly to four kit-generated integral cylindrical printed standoffs without brass standoffs or heat-set inserts. The lower-front standoff is integral to a detachable printed mount arm retained from beneath the base by one M3 screw; that arm must not be fused to the base. Acceptance uses the standard Mini-ITX and SFX interfaces plus the declared GPU, cooler and riser reference envelopes.
